description: Na₈Mg(FeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.72 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.53 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and corners with three equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.62 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.76 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.44 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.54 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.42 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, and corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-1.97 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.97 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-9°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-9°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra.
